question: As of 11 May 2023, what was Toyota’s full-year consolidated operating income outlook for FY2024, in millions of yen?

assessment.coverage_reason: The memo gives the requested full-year consolidated operating income outlook in millions of yen for the correct fiscal year and as-of date.

findings.reason: Toyota’s May 10, 2023 release lists 3,000,000 in the Full-year row under Operating income (million yen) in its consolidated FY2024 forecast, covering April 1, 2023 through March 31, 2024. The figure was a forecast, not an actual result, and was available by May 11.
